title: OTHRYS OS reviewable admitted Mission proposal envelope
goal: Project the latest admitted tablet MISSION_PROPOSAL into a deterministic reviewable OS envelope without creating a canonical mission or starting execution.
laws: The proposal envelope is derived from the admitted tablet intent and Trust Canal receipt state.
Proposal ID remains the DECK-MISSION correlation identity; it is not rewritten as a V2 mission ID.
The envelope exposes project context, objective, admission state and promotion state.
Canonical promotion remains false until a later explicit authority mission.
No missions/*.json file is created from the operator proposal.
No Talos, Hephaestus, Factory, Worker, shell or model execution begins.
Malformed or non-proposal intents produce no proposal envelope.
